name: PriceLabs
description:
PriceLabs is a dynamic pricing and revenue management platform for short-term rentals and hospitality. The PriceLabs connector links Claude securely to your PriceLabs account so you can manage your portfolio conversationally — no dashboards or API calls required.

Ask questions like "Why has occupancy dropped for Sunset Villa?", "Which of my listings haven't had a reservation in 60 days?", or "What are booking trends for coastal properties in Spain?" — and take action directly: set date-specific overrides, update base, minimum, and maximum prices, and more.

What you can do:

Listings & pricing: retrieve listing details, current prices, and pricing configuration; update base/min/max prices and date-specific overrides
Performance & diagnostics: occupancy, pacing, KPIs, and health checks across your portfolio
Reservations & bookings: upcoming check-ins, booking reports, and reservation history
Market intelligence: market trends, comps, and insights from PriceLabs Market Dashboards
Reports & optimization: owner-ready reports, Listing Optimizer insights, and the PriceLabs knowledge base

Works with your existing PriceLabs account and connected PMS. Requires a PriceLabs account; connect via OAuth.

_published_faq.name: How do I add PriceLabs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add PriceLabs to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.pricelabs.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the PriceLabs MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: PriceLabs lists 34 MCP tools, including accept_nudge, delete_listing_date_overrides, diagnose_no_bookings, get_account_review_report, get_available_nudges, get_bookings_report, get_knowledge, get_listing_data, get_listing_date_overrides, get_listing_health_and_recommendations, get_listing_neighborhood_market, and get_listing_optimizer_ranking.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to PriceLabs?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to PriceLabs in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
PriceLabs requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
PriceLabs is developed by PriceLabs. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
